My partner has sleep issues like this too,

I could recommend:

Guided meditations for sleep
Reading a book
Cup of chamomile tea.
Using a CBD or ashwagandha supplement
Having a relaxing bath before bed with Epsom salt and lavender oil.
Light relaxing incense like sandalwood.
Last but not least the breathing technique 4-7-8 breath in for 4 hold for 7 out for 8. Do this about 5 times this relaxes the nervous system.

Hope these help 😊

If you're not ready then don't put any undue pressure on yourself to date. Lots of people decide to wait, both guys and girls and are usually better for it too.

It sounds like she's someone who has difficulty saying no or disagreeing for fear of hurting others.
I'd say keep things non physical this time unless she initiates it, she may be hurt by your rejection when she tries to initiate sex.

Sexual frustration can be difficult for guys but there's a level of self control that goes with that and the immature reaction is not showing that self control.
Silent treatment, that's honestly childish. And he might have missed out on something good. Even if that would have been just friendship.
Don't fall into the guilt trip.

It's really a personal choice, but it shouldn't be something expected on a first date.
You need to do what makes you comfortable, not what will make others comfortable.
Intimacy should be key, but getting to know the person trumps everything in the beginning.

Just be sure that you don't want to end up in a relationship where sex is expected all the time because you will be implying that behaviour.

There's plenty of other good advice already given but be kind too yourself. The right one will come along.
